description: This file contains functions for sending holiday, birthday, and work anniversary reminders within an HR module, including email notifications and event date calculations.

methods.name: send_reminders_in_advance_weekly
methods.description: Triggers sending of weekly holiday reminders based on HR settings.

methods.name: send_reminders_in_advance_monthly
methods.description: Triggers sending of monthly holiday reminders based on HR settings.

methods.name: send_advance_holiday_reminders
methods.description: Sends holiday reminders in advance for a specified frequency ('Weekly' or 'Monthly').

methods.name: send_holidays_reminder_in_advance
methods.description: Sends an email reminder to an employee about upcoming holidays.

methods.name: send_birthday_reminders
methods.description: Sends birthday reminders to employees, including special emails for shared birthdays.

methods.name: get_birthday_reminder_text_and_message
methods.description: Generates reminder text and message content for employee birthdays.

methods.name: send_birthday_reminder
methods.description: Sends a birthday reminder email to specified recipients.

methods.name: get_employees_who_are_born_today
methods.description: Retrieves employees born on the current day, grouped by company.

methods.name: get_employees_having_an_event_today
methods.description: Retrieves employees with a specified event (birthday or work anniversary) today, grouped by company.

methods.name: send_work_anniversary_reminders
methods.description: Sends work anniversary reminders to employees, including shared anniversary emails.

methods.name: get_work_anniversary_reminder_text_and_message
methods.description: Generates reminder text and message content for employee work anniversaries.

methods.name: send_work_anniversary_reminder
methods.description: Sends a work anniversary reminder email to specified recipients.
